name: evoarena-repo-v1
goal: Transfer a shared coding skill to repositories excluded from skill training
selection: One longest original complete chain per repository; require full unique-task coverage
rationale: Repositories used in earlier development runs are assigned to train.
Keep all chains and repeated occurrences of a repository in one partition.
Preserve the only development-unseen Python repository (pytest) for final testing.
Keep two Go repositories for development; this dataset cannot provide unseen Python repositories in both dev and test after prior development exposure.
Test spans a Go web framework, Go monitoring software and a Python test framework.
Assignment uses repository identity, language and prior development exposure, not correctness, patch contents or cache availability.
